stories.title: Inflation remains uncomfortably high despite a retreat in gas prices as challenges mount for the Fed
stories.summary: WASHINGTON (AP) — A key inflation gauge remained high last month even as gas prices cooled in a sign that elevated costs remain a challenge for the Federal Reserve and elected officials in Washington.

stories.title: Lack of snow forces cancellation of World Cup giant slalom races in Quebec
stories.summary: MONT-TREMBLANT — Two women's World Cup giant slalom races scheduled for Dec. 5 and 6 in Mont-Tremblant, Que., have been cancelled due to a lack of snow, the International Ski and Snowboard Federation (FIS) announced Wednesday.
